content.comment_body: Can someone review this small User-Defined Function (UDF) I've created? The start signal activates a delay timer, then after the delay, it triggers a forward output followed by a reverse output. However, pressing reset doesn't do anything, and I can't figure out why. Even if the start input is active, I still want it to reset.
If you press reset before the UDF completes setting the output, nothing happens because the reset only affects the latching relay, not the off-delay timer.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble with the UDF reset functionality. Specifically, the reset command only resets the latching relay and ignores the off-delay timer, which prevents a full reset of the process. This leads to unpredictable control when trying to stop or reset the cycle before it's finished.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the reset feature to immediately and completely stop and reset all relevant states, including timers, regardless of current output or cycle stage.
